name: daw-pro-music-team
description: A team of specialized agents and workflow skills that drive DAW Pro (an AI-native macOS DAW) over its MCP server: plan, compose, arrange, sound-design, mix and bounce a song end-to-end — including modulation, so sounds can move on their own (filter sweeps, tremolo, auto-pan, trance gates and one-knob macros) — plus a demo-director that drives the app's UI over the control port to produce screenshots and narrated videos.
